elliptic_blocks.precision_argument: Expand every numerator in powers of the monic f, with remainders of degree <=2g. Kedlaya Lemmas 2 and 3 bound negative and positive y-power reductions by floor(log_p(abs(y exponent))). For term k the loss is bounded conservatively by floor(log_p(2pk+p))+floor(log_p(2p deg(f)+1)), and the coefficient has valuation >=k+1. This lower bound is nondecreasing for k>=1.
elliptic_blocks.scope: prime-field good reduction, odd monic models degree<p<=19, precision<=4; exact rational reduction, not an optimized arbitrary-field backend
